newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian youth dies of rubber bullet to head.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian youth dies of rubber bullet to head.

text.p: A 14-year-old Palestinian, shot by Israeli soldiers in clashes in Hebron two weeks ago, has died of his wounds, witnesses at his funeral said on Monday.
Nibras Abu Sharkh was hit in the head by a rubber-coated metal bullet. He died in a hospital in Arab East Jerusalem.
Ten Palestinian military jeeps escorted Abu Sharkh's body home to the West Bank town of Dhahriya for burial.
There, about 1,500 Palestinians carrying signs welcoming Abu Sharkh to martyrdom marched two km (one mile) from his home to the village cemetery.
"We lost you. My brother is gone, my brother is gone. I have lost him, I'll never see him again," one young woman cried from the edge of the cemetery.
Three Palestinian police officers gave Abu Sharkh a 21-gun salute. Relatives quickly buried his body, draped in a Palestinian flag.

The divided West Bank town of Hebron was rocked by daily Israeli-Palestinian clashes after a Jewish woman pasted posters on storefronts in the town last month depicting the Moslem Prophet Mohammad as a pig.

Abu Sharkh was the second Palestinian to die in clashes since the posters went up, but the first in Hebron. A 16-year-old boy died last week after being shot in the head during clashes in the West Bank town of Beit Sahour near PLO-ruled Bethlehem.
The violence died down last week after Palestinian police deployed along the line dividing the Israeli and PLO-controlled sections of the city.
